title: Quantum-Inspired Optimizer
outcome: Apply annealing and tensor-inspired heuristics to hard scheduling and search problems
breakthrough: The platform explores solution spaces ordinary greedy algorithms miss

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Quantum Inspired Optimizer Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Quantum Inspired Optimizer Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed entities, capabilities, jobs, events, state transitions, and outputs required to apply annealing and tensor-inspired heuristics to hard scheduling and search problems, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for new execution models, alternate protocols, unconventional databases, spatial computing, and high-risk prototypes; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Quantum Inspired Optimizer Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: apply annealing and tensor-inspired heuristics to hard scheduling and search problems.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Quantum Inspired Optimizer Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Quantum Inspired Optimizer Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using rapid prototyping, benchmark-driven selection, sandboxing, and experimental algorithm design.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Quantum Inspired Optimizer Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the technology playground, benchmark arena, protocol visualizer, and experimental app launcher, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Quantum Inspired Optimizer into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Quantum Inspired Optimizer Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Quantum Inspired Optimizer Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: The platform explores solution spaces ordinary greedy algorithms miss. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
